receipts.prompt: Edit the first photo. Keep it exactly as framed: the same camera, room shape, windows, doors and stairs. Furniture and lighting may be replaced, and selected furniture or decor may be added where there is visible space. Keep doors, windows, stairs and circulation clear. Do not change the architecture or camera. Do not claim that sizes, fit or electrical installation have been verified. Keep the first photo’s flooring unchanged; only selected rugs may overlay it. The owner requires these existing items to remain unchanged and in place: "Exact camera, room shape, all three bay windows, original pendant, trim and doorway.". This takes priority over the inspiration selections. Make only these changes, following the owner’s brief: the open space in window bay becomes compact oak writing desk facing center window; the floor in front of desk becomes one upholstered blue desk chair facing desk; the blank wall on right becomes low oak bookcase with books; the bare center floor becomes soft blue-gray area rug; the empty right corner becomes brass floor lamp; the bay corner floor becomes potted plant. Paint the walls "Alabaster SW 7008" (#edeae0), matte to eggshell. Leave everything else exactly as it is. Natural daylight. Photorealistic.

changes.becomes: compact oak writing desk facing center window
one upholstered blue desk chair facing desk
